scenarios.setup: A at 40 life resolves Cloudblazer entry ability with library top cards C1,C2 and no modifiers.
scenarios.expected: One life-gain instruction changes A to 42; then C1 and C2 are drawn individually in library order. There is one noncard ability resolution, not two separately respondable effects.

scenarios.setup: A at 40 life resolves Elite Guardmage entry ability with card C1 on top.
scenarios.expected: A gains 3 life, then draws C1; the creature retains flying. Both instructions use the captured trigger controller.

scenarios.setup: A at 40 life resolves Inspiring Overseer entry ability with card C1 on top.
scenarios.expected: A gains 1 life, then draws C1. The definition also retains its complete flying keyword.

scenarios.setup: Construct Priest of Ancient Lore from its reviewed source tuple and resolve its entry ability.
scenarios.expected: Use gain 1 life then draw 1 with no flying ability. Its program may share the effect sequence with Inspiring Overseer while retaining a distinct identity/source version and different keyword set.

scenarios.setup: A Cloudblazer ability is on the stack; its source leaves before that ability resolves.
scenarios.expected: The same captured ability remains; A gains 2 life then draws 2. The ability disappears after resolution, without moving an invented card to a graveyard.

scenarios.setup: Cloudblazer triggers under A; an independently supplied control-change fixture makes B control its source before resolution.
scenarios.expected: A remains controller of that ability and receives both life and cards. B receives neither simply because B now controls the source.
scenarios.fixtureKind: source-bound ability plus synthetic control-change fixture

scenarios.setup: A has simultaneously captured Cloudblazer and Priest of Ancient Lore entry abilities and chooses their stack order.
scenarios.expected: A orders whole ability instances. If Cloudblazer is on top, its gain 2 and both draws finish before Priest can resolve; the engine must not interleave the two abilities instruction by instruction.
scenarios.fixtureKind: source-bound abilities plus synthetic simultaneous-entry fixture

scenarios.setup: A is active; A and B each control a captured ordered entry ability in one ordinary placement cohort.
scenarios.expected: A places their ability first and B next. B’s top ability resolves as one ordered sequence after the required passes; A’s remains below it.
scenarios.fixtureKind: source-bound abilities plus synthetic simultaneous-entry fixture

scenarios.setup: A has exactly one library card when Cloudblazer entry ability resolves.
scenarios.expected: A gains 2 life and draws the available card, then records the failed draw attempt. Finish and remove the ability before the next state-based checkpoint eliminates A for the failed draw.

scenarios.setup: A has an empty library when Cloudblazer entry ability resolves.
scenarios.expected: The life gain still occurs; no cards enter A’s hand. The failed draw state is checked only after this ability finishes; A then loses at the state-based checkpoint.

scenarios.setup: A synthetic typed sequence draws 2 and then gains 3 life; A has one card in the library.
scenarios.expected: Draw the available card and retain failed-draw state, then still perform the later gain 3 life instruction before ability completion and elimination. This reversed sequence is not claimed to be one of the four source cards.

scenarios.setup: A Cloudblazer ability resolves while synthetic observers watch life gain and each individual draw.
scenarios.expected: Capture observers at their actual events. Do not place them, request APNAP ordering, perform state-based actions, or grant priority between gain 2, draw 1, draw 1. Process the later checkpoint after the parent ability finishes.
scenarios.fixtureKind: source-bound ability plus synthetic observer fixtures

scenarios.setup: Save while a Cloudblazer ability is on the stack, reopen, then resolve using accepted command receipts.
scenarios.expected: Preserve captured controller, source instance/version, immutable ordered program, stack position and command ordering. Produce the same life, hand, library and ability-removal result as uninterrupted execution; exact accepted-command retries return their original receipts.

scenarios.setup: A resolves Elite Guardmage while B observes.
scenarios.expected: Expose life gain, public ability source/controller and hand-count changes; the drawn card’s private identity is visible only to its entitled observer. No physical spell-card object is invented for the trigger.

scenarios.setup: A synthetic self-entry ability says A may draw 1; A intends to decline.
scenarios.expected: It still triggers and is placed normally. Intention does not suppress capture or placement; request A’s option only when that ability is resolving.
prerequisites: future optional trigger contract; no candidate card is claimed

scenarios.setup: The synthetic optional draw 1 ability begins resolution with a nonempty library and no prohibition.
scenarios.expected: Offer an owned accept/decline decision to the captured trigger controller. Accept draws exactly1 and then completes the same ability; it does not create a new stack object.

scenarios.setup: A chooses decline for the same optional draw 1 ability.
scenarios.expected: Perform no draw and no failed-draw marking, then complete/remove that ability and continue the ordinary checkpoint.

scenarios.setup: A may draw 1 at resolution but has no library cards.
scenarios.expected: Accept remains a legal choice despite the empty library. If chosen, the attempt fails and A loses at the next state-based checkpoint; decline makes no draw attempt.

scenarios.setup: A future synthetic continuous effect says A cannot draw cards while the optional draw 1 choice is offered.
scenarios.expected: Accept is unavailable; an empty library is not the same as a draw prohibition. Do not generalize the empty-library exception into permission to ignore a cannot-draw effect.

scenarios.setup: A synthetic effect lets A choose to draw 2 while an independent rule effect limits A to 1 card drawn this turn.
scenarios.expected: The choice to draw 2 is unavailable. Distinguish this from a mandatory draw 2 instruction, which may be partially performed under the same restriction.

scenarios.setup: A captured an optional self-entry ability, then B gains control of its source before resolution.
scenarios.expected: A owns the resolution choice and receives any accepted self effect. Do not hand the choice to B by consulting current source control.

scenarios.setup: The engine is waiting for an optional resolution choice.
scenarios.expected: No ordinary pass, cast, attack or response window exists inside that resolution. Accept only the owned resolution-choice command; resume the same ability at the same cursor.
prerequisites: future optional continuation and command contract

scenarios.setup: Save and reopen while optional resolution is paused; accept once, retry exactly the accepted command ID, then submit a new stale command.
scenarios.expected: Reopen retains the same controller, decision ID, ability instance and continuation. Apply the chosen branch once; the accepted-command retry returns its recorded receipt, while the new stale command is rejected.
prerequisites: versioned coordinator receipt and replay support

scenarios.setup: A synthetic optional gain 3 life choice resolves while a separately implemented effect forbids A from gaining life.
scenarios.expected: Do not offer an impossible gain-life branch as legal. Resolve the decline branch; this is a future interaction prerequisite rather than current-source coverage.

scenarios.setup: Attempt to admit the complete current source body of Bookwurm.
scenarios.expected: Remain unsupported: Its graveyard-to-library activated ability remains unimplemented despite the matching gain 3 and draw 1 entry line.
prerequisites: complete-body constructor validation; no partial-text fallback

scenarios.setup: Attempt to admit the complete current source body of Mulldrifter.
scenarios.expected: Remain unsupported: Its evoke ability and alternative casting path remain unimplemented despite a familiar draw 2 entry line.
prerequisites: complete-body constructor validation; no partial-text fallback

scenarios.setup: Attempt to admit the complete current source body of Hero in Training.
scenarios.expected: Remain unsupported: Its later conditional gain-life instruction must not be erased when recognizing the preceding draw.
prerequisites: complete-body constructor validation; no partial-text fallback

scenarios.setup: Attempt to admit the complete current source body of Disciple of Bolas.
scenarios.expected: Remain unsupported: Sacrifice, variable X and source-power history require their own explicit semantics.
prerequisites: complete-body constructor validation; no partial-text fallback

scenarios.setup: Attempt to admit the complete current source body of Tataru Taru.
scenarios.expected: Remain unsupported: Another player’s optional draw and the additional Treasure trigger require different domains and dependencies.
prerequisites: complete-body constructor validation; no partial-text fallback

scenarios.setup: Attempt to admit the complete current source body of Dovin's Acuity.
scenarios.expected: Remain unsupported: Enchantment characteristics and the additional instant-cast return trigger are outside the ordinary creature constructor.
prerequisites: complete-body constructor validation; no partial-text fallback

scenarios.setup: Attempt to admit the complete current source body of Invasion of Dominaria // Serra Faithkeeper.
scenarios.expected: Remain unsupported: Battle/Siege, another face and its surrounding mechanics remain outside this creature-only proposal.
prerequisites: complete-body constructor validation; no partial-text fallback

scenarios.setup: Swap Cloudblazer’s proposed gain 2/draw 2 order, alter a count, or omit flying while keeping its identity.
scenarios.expected: The altered definition cannot inherit the reviewed full-body binding or prepared proof. Reject mismatched whole-body/program/characteristic evidence.
prerequisites: future exact ordered constructor and prepared admission

scenarios.setup: Produce a source coverage report for this bounded scan.
scenarios.expected: Report4 ordered research candidates and0 optional candidates; synthetic optional tests must never increase real-card identity coverage or imply implementation/execution.
